title: Kouryuu Sangoku Engi
overview:
Based on the highly acclaimed "Ryuuou Sangokushi", which broke new ground in the world of PC historical simulation games, with many original elements added!

- The game progresses entirely in real time. Domestic affairs, recruitment, diplomacy - everything proceeds in real time. Enjoy a pleasant sense of tension that cannot be compared to conventional command-based simulation games.
- Freely remodel your castle walls! Remodel the layout of the walls and gates surrounding your fortress city as you like. Of course, remodeling changes the strategic conditions of defensive battles and the population your fortress city can hold. The process of completing the walls also happens in real time. Build a fortress city all your own!
- Features a "Map of All China" showing ruins and ancient battlefields at a glance! View each scenario's rulers' spheres of influence and detailed explanations of place names on a polygon-drawn 3D map of China.
- Generals talk! The "Direct Appeal" system. From vital information you can only hear through a direct appeal to simple gossip about colleagues, generals will talk to you about all sorts of things. Not only is it fun to watch, but advanced players should be able to read a general's personality and the compatibility between generals from what they say.
- Many other original features as well!!

パソコンの歴史シミュレーションゲーム界に新境地を切り開き、大好評を博した「龍王三國史」をベースにオリジナル要素を多数追加！

◆ゲーム進行は全てリアルタイム
内政・登用・外交等、全てがリアルタイムで進行します。従来のコマンド型の一般のシミュレーションゲームとは比較にならない心地よい緊迫感を楽しめます。
◆城壁を自由自在に改築可能！
城塞都市を囲む城壁、城門の配置を自分の好みに改築できます。もちろん改築により、防衛戦の戦略的条件や、城塞都市の許容人口が変化します。城壁完成までの過程ももちろんリアルタイムです。自分だけの城塞都市を作りましょう！
◆旧跡・古戦場等が一目で分かる「中国全土地図」採用！
各シナリオの君主の勢力範囲や、地名の詳細な説明などを、ポリゴンで描かれた中国の立体地図で見ることができます。
◆武将が喋る！「直訴」システム
「直訴」によってしか聞けない超重要情報から、単なる同僚の悪口まで、武将は様々な事について話しかけてきます。見て楽しいだけでなく、上級者ならその発言から、その武将の性格や武将同士の相性まで読みとれるはずです。
◆他、様々なオリジナル機能を採用！！
